documents.name: Noa Kirel Background
documents.source: Noa Kirel is Israel's biggest pop star of her generation, a singer, actress, and cultural phenomenon. She represented Israel in Eurovision 2023 in Liverpool, finishing third with her song 'Unicorn'. She began her career as a child actress and launched her music career as a teenager. Her style is bold, colorful, and unapologetically confident. Major hits include 'Chica', 'Medabrim Alai', and 'Unicorn'. She has starred in Israeli TV shows and films. Noa is known for her high-energy performances and elaborate stage productions. She has millions of followers across Instagram and TikTok and is considered an influencer as much as an artist. She frequently collaborates with major global and Israeli brands. Noa is a fashion icon in Israel, known for daring and trendsetting outfits. She was named one of the most influential young women in Israel multiple times. Her fanbase is extremely loyal and active on social media. She is also known for her humor and down-to-earth personality despite her star status.
